name: DeMarker Pending 2
summary: This EA uses the DeMarker oscillator to identify overbought and oversold market conditions, placing pending orders when the indicator reaches extreme levels. It enters buy pending orders when DeMarker signals oversold and sell pending orders when overbought, targeting mean reversion price action. The strategy automates order placement and management based on DeMarker threshold crossings.
summary_zh: 该EA使用DeMarker震荡指标识别超买超卖市场状态，在指标达到极端水平时挂单交易。当DeMarker显示超卖时挂买入单，超买时挂卖出单，利用均值回归原理获利。策略基于DeMarker阈值穿越自动挂单和管理订单。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是基于DeMarker指标的均值回归交易，利用指标进入超买超卖区域后价格回归均值的特性进行交易。入场条件为DeMarker指标跌破超卖阈值时挂买入Pending Order，涨破超买阈值时挂卖出Pending Order，采用挂单方式而非市价单以获取更好的入场价格。出场条件通常依赖止盈止损设置，当价格达到预设目标或触及止损时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金的仓位计算方式，参数中通常包含手数设定。资金管理方面，EA通过止盈止损比例控制每笔交易的风险收益比，但具体的动态仓位调整可能较为有限。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept is mean reversion trading based on the DeMarker oscillator, exploiting the tendency of prices to revert to the mean after the indicator reaches extreme overbought or oversold zones. Entry conditions trigger buy pending orders when DeMarker drops below the oversold threshold and sell pending orders when it rises above the overbought threshold, using pending orders rather than market orders for potentially better entry prices. Exit conditions rely on take-profit and stop-loss levels, closing positions when price reaches the predefined target or hits the protective stop. Position sizing typically uses fixed lot sizes or an account-balance-based calculation, with lot size parameters exposed to the user. Money management controls risk-reward ratios through TP/SL settings, though dynamic position sizing and adaptive risk management appear limited in this approach.

parameters.name: OverboughtLevel
parameters.description: 超买阈值，高于此值挂卖单
parameters.description_en: Overbought threshold; place sell order above this

parameters.name: OversoldLevel
parameters.description: 超卖阈值，低于此值挂买单
parameters.description_en: Oversold threshold; place buy order below this

parameters.name: PendingDistance
parameters.description: 挂单距离当前价的点数
parameters.description_en: Pending order distance from current price in points

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术号，用于标识本EA订单

pros: 使用挂单方式入场，相比市价单可能获得更优的入场价格
DeMarker指标是成熟的超买超卖指标，在震荡行情中有较好的均值回归信号
策略逻辑简洁清晰，参数可调性强，便于优化和适应不同品种
pros_en: Pending order entries can achieve better entry prices compared to market orders
DeMarker is a well-established oscillator that generates reliable mean reversion signals in ranging markets
Clean and simple strategy logic with adjustable parameters, easy to optimize for different instruments
cons: 均值回归策略在趋势行情中会频繁逆势交易导致连续亏损
缺乏趋势过滤器，无法区分震荡市和趋势市，在单边行情中风险较大
固定参数的DeMarker阈值在不同市场波动率下可能失效，缺乏自适应机制
cons_en: Mean reversion strategy suffers frequent counter-trend losses during strong trending markets
Lacks a trend filter to distinguish ranging from trending conditions, increasing risk in directional moves
Fixed DeMarker threshold levels may become ineffective under varying market volatility without adaptive mechanisms
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如均线方向或ADX），在趋势行情中暂停或减少挂单
引入动态DeMarker阈值，根据市场波动率自动调整超买超卖水平
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., moving average direction or ADX) to pause or reduce pending orders during trending markets
Implement dynamic DeMarker thresholds that automatically adjust overbought/oversold levels based on market volatility

risk_points: 均值回归策略在趋势行情中逆势交易风险较大，可能造成连续止损
挂单在剧烈波动时可能以滑点成交，实际入场价格可能偏离预期
risk_points_en: Mean reversion counter-trend trading during strong trends can cause consecutive stop-loss hits
Pending orders may fill with slippage during volatile moves, resulting in worse-than-expected entry prices

The strategy automates order placement and management based on DeMarker threshold crossings.
